item.description: Indian markets open sharply higher as global sentiment improves after Donald Trump steps back from tariff threats against Europe over Greenland, easing geopolitical and trade worries.

item.description: Trump withdraws tariff threat against European countries over Greenland and rules out using force to seize the territory, easing weeks of rising tension between Washington and its European allies.

item.title: DMK criticises Madras High Court ruling in Sanatana Dharma case
